clips.title: The story
paras: Burning Blade initiates train in Dustwind Cave, high above Razorwind Canyon northeast of Razor Hill. The cave is both a training ground and a covert refuge for the cult in Durotar.

Dustwind Cave overlooks Razorwind Canyon, close to Razor Hill and a perilous threat to the town. The Burning Blade trains new recruits here beneath the notice of Horde authorities. Cultists teach initiates forbidden dark magic and demonology, preparing them to undermine the young orcish realm from within Durotar's borders.

Those who enter Dustwind Cave risk the Burning Blade's corruptions. Cultists channel volatile dark arts, including felblood afflictions. Their work shows how firmly the cult holds to the demonic legacy Thrall fought to banish. Clearing the cabal from the cave matters to Durotar's fragile peace.
